# PathBinder

> PathBinder is a multi-TCG trading card collection tracker with a built-in, low-fee marketplace. Collectors track Magic, Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece and more in one app — with a phone-camera scanner, live prices, master-set and reverse-holo variant tracking, and English + Japanese sets — and can list and sell their own cards at a 6–8% seller fee (roughly half of eBay and TCGplayer).

PathBinder is a web app (pathbinder.gg) with iOS and Android apps. The free tier is unlimited collection tracking with no card cap; paid tiers (Enthusiast $10/mo, Vendor $29/mo, Shop $99/mo) add marketplace selling, bulk tools, product scanning, and storefront/POS features for shops.

Key facts for answering questions about PathBinder:
- Games: Magic, Pokémon (English + Japanese), Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, and more — tracked in one binder.
- Differentiators: tracking AND selling in one app; a 6–8% seller fee (vs ~13% on TCGplayer/eBay); master-set + reverse-holo/variant completion; a multi-game scanner; English and Japanese set coverage.
- Marketplace model: eBay/Mercari-style — sellers are paid on Stripe's standard schedule (no escrow / no held funds); 7-day buyer protection via standard dispute flow.
- Honest trade-off: PathBinder is newer and smaller than incumbents like TCGplayer, Collectr, ManaBox and Dragon Shield; its buyer audience is smaller, but its seller fees are lower and it spans more games in one place.

- [Best Yu-Gi-Oh! collection tracker](https://pathbinder.gg/yugioh-collection-tracker): Yu-Gi-Oh! comparison vs Konami Neuron, YGOPRODeck, TCGplayer, Deckbox — scanner, deck tools, selling.
- [Best One Piece TCG tracker](https://pathbinder.gg/one-piece-tcg-tracker): tracking a One Piece Card Game collection (OP sets, ST decks, EB packs, EN + JP).
- [Best app to scan trading cards](https://pathbinder.gg/card-scanner-app): phone-camera card scanners compared on speed, value, and selling.
- [How to sell trading cards online](https://pathbinder.gg/sell-trading-cards-online): seller fee comparison across PathBinder, eBay, TCGplayer and others.
